metadata.name: ds_interviewer_eval_cases
metadata.description: Unified eval cases for both retrieval-only evaluation and Agent1 plus Agent2 retrieval evaluation. Each jd field is a short paraphrase grounded in an official company job posting or official company career guidance page, not a synthetic role invented from scratch.
metadata.label_policy: expected_categories and expected_skills must match labels already present in data/questions_normalized.jsonl. The evaluation script validates this before running retrieval.

modes.retrieval_only: Use the human-written query field directly, then evaluate retrieved questions against expected_categories and expected_skills.
modes.agent1_retrieval: Run Agent1 on jd and user_desc, use Agent1 output skills as retrieval queries, then evaluate retrieved questions against the same expected labels.

metadata.relevance_rule: A retrieved question is relevant if its category matches expected_categories or any taxonomy skill matches expected_skills.

cases.role_title: Machine Learning Data Scientist, Input Experience
cases.query: ML data scientist model evaluation user metrics SQL experimentation
cases.jd: The role focuses on measuring user experience quality for ML-powered input systems. The candidate will analyze product metrics, design user studies, evaluate model performance, write SQL and Python, and communicate data-driven recommendations to engineering and design partners.
cases.user_desc: I have two years of product analytics experience, strong SQL, basic Python, and some A/B testing experience. I am weaker on machine learning theory and model evaluation metrics.
